3d_player_controller.subject:
Record Godot 4.8's new mipmap import keys

Opening a project in Godot 4.8 adds mipmaps/preserve_alpha_test_coverage
and mipmaps/alpha_test_threshold to every texture .import file, both at the
engine's own defaults, so nothing about how these textures are imported
actually changes. Committing them stops the same diff reappearing on every
machine that opens the project.

Where animation .tres files are caught by the same pass, they are only
re-serialized: the largest value change is 2e-07, float rounding rather
than edited animation, and every custom method track survives intact.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
